title: 富兰克林邓普顿David Mann：香港市场资金流入90亿美元，下一步产品线怎么走？
speaker: David Mann

segments.en: So what's next for you? Do you have more ETFs in the pipeline?
segments.zh: 接下来有什么计划？还有更多ETF在筹备中吗？

segments.en: Yeah, so we've certainly been busy and it's been fun watching our global platform get to 85 billion.
segments.zh: 是的，我们一直很忙，全球平台规模达到850亿，令人振奋。

segments.en: The China AMC partnership is very exciting in terms of leaning on their local Chinese expertise and then combining it with our global presence.
segments.zh: 与华夏基金的合作非常令人期待，借助其本地中国专长，结合我们的全球布局。

segments.en: So we're certainly actively working with them on our pipeline and look forward to sort of the next iteration of local products.
segments.zh: 我们正积极与他们推进产品线，期待本地产品的下一轮迭代。

segments.en: We think Hong Kong is a great market. We think access to the mainland China investors is very exciting.
segments.zh: 我们认为香港市场非常优质，能够触达内地投资者令人兴奋。

segments.en: There's no denying the inflows that we've seen within the Hong Kong market, which I think is roughly 9 billion US this calendar year.
segments.zh: 香港市场的资金流入不容忽视，本年度大约90亿美元。

segments.en: So really looking to beef up our latest manufacturing center.
segments.zh: 因此我们确实希望强化最新的产品制造中心。
